_meta.rule: Every answer the pipeline gives must trace to a key in this file, data/stories.json, or something you said to Claude. If it can't, the field is UNKNOWN and the application pauses.
_meta.how_to_use: Copy to data/profile.json (autopilot.py init does this), replace every value, delete keys you don't want used. Keys starting with _ are notes.

identity._address_use: Only filled when an address field is REQUIRED. Otherwise city/state only.

education.school: The University of Texas at Austin
education._school_aliases: Other spellings dropdowns use. The first one found in a dropdown wins.
education._school_search_hint: What to type in a school search box that needs a prefix.
education._grad_rule: If a form only has terms, the term is derived: month 1-5 = Spring, 6-8 = Summer, 9-12 = Fall.
education._gpa_scope: Say what your GPA covers. If a form asks for something you can't answer truthfully (e.g. cumulative across schools), the pipeline pauses.

work_auth._authorization_basis_options: Words to look for in 'basis of your work authorization' dropdowns, in order.

logistics._how_did_you_hear: Dropdown options to try, in order. The text value is used for free-text boxes.
logistics._current_title_by_track: Optional: how your current/most recent title should read for each track in config/preferences.toml.
logistics.salary_rule: If pay is listed, answer with the listed range. Otherwise: 'Flexible, in line with your intern pay band.'

eeo_voluntary._rule: Each value is either a list of option labels to try in order, or one of: yes | no | decline. Use 'decline' for anything you'd rather not share. Never guessed.

consents._rule: true = Claude may tick it. false = Claude pauses and asks you (or declines, for SMS / future-contact boxes).

legal._rule: Facts only you know. null = unknown, so the pipeline asks.

experience.title: Software Engineering Intern
experience._title_by_track: Optional per-track wording of the same title, only if truthful.

skills._unverified: Skills you have but don't want claimed in essays until you confirm them.

product_usage._rule: Products you actually use, and how. Essays only mention usage that's listed here.
product_usage.Notion: class notes and team project docs
